subject: POC plan & RACI for ClearLake trial
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearlakehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC planning follow-up — ClearLake trial

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the POC/trial: 

High-level success criteria (what ClearLake will evaluate):
- End-to-end latency for typical clinical prompt <= 600ms (95th pct)
- Cost per 1k tokens meets projected budget (you quoted $X target)
- No PII leakage; all logs retained per ClearLake policy (30 days)
- Integration works with your existing triage workflow (API + webhook)

Evaluation plan & timeline (proposal):
- Week 1 (3/8–3/12): Kickoff, access & infra prep, ingest sample prompts
- Week 2 (3/15–3/19): Run representative traffic, tuning, and monitoring
- Week 3 (3/22–3/26): Final validation against success criteria, wrap-up

Ownership (draft RACI):
- ClearLake app owner: Marcus Holt (responsible)
- ClearLake infra/IT: your IT team (we need name/point of contact)
- Redwood SE: Aditya Rao (responsible for infra/provisioning + tuning)
- Redwood CSM/POC lead: Marissa Cole (account lead, single point of contact)
- Security/compliance: ClearLake InfoSec (review of network & data flows)
- Procurement/contract: ClearLake procurement (we understand timeline target is mid-March)

Requested confirmations from you:
1) Confirm owners above (especially IT/infra contact).
2) Confirm procurement target date (you mentioned end of week of 3/15?)
3) Any additional success criteria we should include?

I've attached our POC template (clearlake-poc-template.xlsx) and a sample network diagram showing peering options — both are examples, we can adapt.

Proposed next step: 30-min kickoff on Monday 3/8 to align owners and start infra provisioning. Are you available?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Hi all — quick technical note on provisioning and timeline.

Thanks for looping Rajiv. From Redwood's side I will: 
- Provision a dedicated trial endpoint (quantized model variant) in your preferred region (us-west) — ETA 2 business days after access confirmed.
- Enable prefix/KV caching and baseline batching for the trial; will share expected throughput figures once we see sample workload.

What I need from Rajiv (ideally before Mon kickoff):
- VPC peering details or IPs for whitelisting (CIDR)
- A staging service account or short-lived key with limited scope (or we can use a tunnel)
- Any proxy/firewall inspection that would break long-lived streaming — let me know if you have an egress proxy and the domain allowlist

If Rajiv can confirm access by EOD Mon 3/8, I can have the endpoint up by Wed 3/10 and we can start validation the same week. If procurement delays contract signing beyond 3/19, we can still run a short internal trial but will need a contract to continue past initial evaluation.

Happy to sync in kickoff — I'll prepare a short infra checklist and share it in the invite.

- Aditya
